You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 14 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-14/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools, fill scripts, repair brief, probe and diagnosis prompts are in the same directory). Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row.
